# ET's Lawn Care & More

> The grass is greener with us. Insured, owner-operated lawn care and landscaping serving Springfield, Missouri and the surrounding towns. 5 years in business, free estimates on every job.

- Owner: Eli
- Phone: (417) 849-7131 (call or text)
- Email: etslawncare5@gmail.com
- Based in: Springfield, Missouri
- Service area: Springfield and surrounding towns; travels 75+ miles for larger jobs
- Customers: residential and commercial
- Scheduling: one-time jobs and recurring service, no contract required
- Insured: yes
- Estimates: always free

## Pricing

- Lawn mowing: $50 minimum; $95-$135 per acre depending on terrain, obstacles and grass height
- Leaf and seasonal cleanups: $150 minimum, final price based on property size and leaf volume
- Everything else (landscaping, aeration and overseeding, fertilization and weed control, mulch and rock, shrub trimming, pavers and hardscaping, pressure washing, snow removal) is quoted per property after a free estimate

## Services

- [Lawn Mowing & Trimming](https://etslawns.com/services/mowing-trimming.html): Recurring or one-time mowing for residential and commercial properties.
- [Landscaping & Bed Cleanups](https://etslawns.com/services/landscaping-bed-cleanups.html): Bed cleanups, outdoor improvements, and larger landscaping projects.
- [Leaf & Seasonal Cleanups](https://etslawns.com/services/leaf-seasonal-cleanups.html): One-time cleanups starting at $150, based on property size and conditions.
- [Aeration & Overseeding](https://etslawns.com/services/aeration-overseeding.html): Core aeration and overseeding with free property-specific estimates.
- [Fertilization & Weed Control](https://etslawns.com/services/fertilization-weed-control.html): Fertilization and weed-control service tailored to your property.
- [Mulch & Rock Installation](https://etslawns.com/services/mulch-rock-installation.html): Refresh landscape beds and improve curb appeal with a free custom estimate.
- [Shrub Trimming](https://etslawns.com/services/shrub-trimming.html): Professional shrub trimming for a neater, more polished property.
- [Pavers & Small Hardscaping](https://etslawns.com/services/pavers-small-hardscaping.html): Pavers and smaller outdoor projects designed around your space.
- [Snow Removal](https://etslawns.com/services/snow-removal.html): Seasonal snow-removal help for residential and commercial properties.
- [Pressure Washing](https://etslawns.com/services/pressure-washing.html): Pressure washing to freshen up exterior surfaces around your property.
